summary: ACNB Corporation filed an 8-K announcing a comprehensive capital allocation update: a regular quarterly cash dividend of $0.42/share, a special cash dividend of $0.50/share (both payable June 15, 2026 to record holders as of June 1, 2026), and a new share repurchase program authorizing up to 310,000 shares (~3.0% of outstanding). The prior June 2025 buyback plan was completed and superseded. The Board approved all measures on April 28, 2026. No advisor or fairness opinion was cited. The combined dividends and buyback represent a return of capital to shareholders. Watch for execution pace of the buyback and any future capital actions.
